blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — Children with cancer in Iligan City can now receive free treatment closer to home following the opening of a pediatric oncology unit at the local government-run Gregorio T. Lluch Memorial Hospital (GTLMH) on Thursday, Nov. 12. The Iligan City Information Office said the new facility was established to address the difficulties faced by families who previously had to travel to Cagayan de Oro or Davao cities to seek cancer treatment for their children. The unit provides free medical care, medicines and therapy for pediatric cancer patients in the public hospital. READ: Iligan City hospital run by nuns turns […]...
